description: The file defines an abstract PHP class named tlFilterControl, which encapsulates common GUI logic for managing filters and settings in the TestLink project. It includes properties and methods for handling filter configurations, user input, filter mode toggling, custom fields, and tree menu building, intended for subclass extension for specific use cases like test cases or requirements.

classes.name: tlFilterControl
classes.description: An abstract class providing GUI filter management logic for a test management system, meant to be extended by subclasses for handling specific object types like test cases or requirements.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes configuration, user input, filter modes, and settings upon object creation.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up object references when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: read_config
methods.description: Reads static GUI configuration options from project settings.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Loads user input from HTTP requests, session data, and handles filter resets and filter mode toggles.

methods.name: init_filter_custom_fields
methods.description: Initializes custom field filters based on application areas and user input, generating HTML snippets for filtering.

methods.name: init_advanced_filter_mode
methods.description: Determines whether advanced filter mode is active based on configuration and user input.

methods.name: init_settings
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize active settings; implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: init_filters
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize filters based on data; implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: get_active_filters
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve current active filters; implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: build_tree_menu
methods.description: Abstract method to generate the tree menu structure for GUI display.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve custom fields relevant to filtering; implemented in subclasses.
